static_traits.name: Lin Jie
static_traits.occupation: Works three jobs at the same time; dreams of becoming a baseball commentator
static_traits.marital_status: Unmarried; has proposed to a girlfriend of three years
static_traits.social_status: Has friends and a girlfriend who can provide support, but has not yet opened up to them about self-doubt
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no similar psychological problems occurred before; has not received psychotherapy
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good logic, high cooperation; able to self-reflect and do cognitive restructuring, but has evident tendencies toward self-negation and self-reproach

basic_info.main_problem: Self-doubt and feelings of inadequacy about my dream of becoming a baseball commentator. These feelings began after I proposed, and are worsened by my tendency to judge myself with negative labels, affecting my motivation and self-esteem.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize these feelings of self-doubt are hindering me from moving toward my dream job and affecting my overall well-being, which prompted me to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: After proposing to his girlfriend of three years, Lin Jie began to show marked self-doubt and feelings of inadequacy, worrying that he would be unable to realize his dream of becoming a baseball commentator. This important life event increased his thinking about future roles and responsibilities and worsened his worries about failure and being judged, which in turn affected his intimate relationship and daily state.

The client has long juggled three jobs, with considerable stress. When mistakes occur at work (such as forgetting to complete tasks on time), the client tends to evaluate themselves with negative labels such as 'I am a failure / useless', and generalizes individual mistakes into overall ability problems. This way of thinking exacerbates self-doubt and reduced motivation.

core_beliefs: I am not competent at public speaking/commentary work

special_situations.event: Forgetting to complete tasks on time at work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make a mistake, it means I am unqualified and not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Engages in harsh self-criticism toward the self, treating individual mistakes as proof of overall ability

special_situations.event: Thinking about pursuing becoming a baseball commentator or imagining oneself on stage commentating
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not perform perfectly from the start or am not naturally suited to outward expression, I am doomed to fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Chooses to work behind the scenes hiding behind the computer, avoiding real practice or public exposure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I would probably be a terrible commentator

special_situations.event: After proposing, facing more responsibilities and future planning
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not successful in my career, I will disappoint my partner, showing that I am not worthy of acceptance
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing expression of real worries, avoiding seeking support from family and friends to avoid being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I fail in pursuing my dream, I will drag down the relationship and disappoint her

special_situations.event: Juggling three jobs in a row; tight time limits practice
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot keep practicing at the ideal intensity, I will never reach the goal
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Replacing systematic practice with watching motivational content, avoiding step-by-step practice
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never do it well / there is simply no time to practice well

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and supported, to pursue the ideal career with peace of mind, and to be accepted in intimate relationships
core_conflict.fear: Fears exposing shortcomings, being judged and failing, thereby disappointing the partner and damaging the relationship
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of security through self-criticism and avoiding exposure
Maintains low expectations and hides behind the scenes to reduce being evaluated
Internalizes high standards as self-requirements to gain a sense of control

object_relations.self_representation: A self that is not good enough and prone to failure
object_relations.object_representation: Picky judges who will negate me (supervisor, audience, significant others)

object_relations.self_representation: A self who diligently takes on and multitasks
object_relations.object_representation: Others who need one's steadiness and responsibility (partner/environment)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes a behavioral experiment of 'deliberately making a small mistake and observing the consequences'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interprets potential mistakes as leading to being looked down on or punished by others (regarding others as harsh judges)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responds in the tone of objective analysis and evidence gathering, emphasizing 'data / results', downplaying emotional experience.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When a mistake at work is brought up
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing others will rebuke oneself like an authority, equated with total negation
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Uses self-blaming and deprecating words (such as 'I can't do it'), apologizes repeatedly, and defends the self less.

manifestations: After the proposal, sense of responsibility for roles and future choices strengthens; worries that pursuing dreams will bring negative consequences
Wavering between multiple jobs and pursuing dreams, fearing making a choice and bearing the consequences
outcomes: Avoids practice and public attempts; progress toward the dream is blocked

manifestations: Although there is a support network of friends and a girlfriend, has not yet opened up to them about self-doubt
在压力下倾向于独自承受
outcomes: Emotional burden increases, support resources are hard to translate into actual help
Reduced relationship communication, increased sense of alienation

positive_force: The partner's supportive attitude is positive and willing to communicate (the client believes sharing plans with his girlfriend would help)
Having a social support network of friends and a girlfriend
Able to manage three jobs simultaneously, having some persistence and executive ability
Positive attitude, willing to try behavioral experiments and conduct cognitive restructuring
negative_force: Negative self-labeling and overgeneralization, prone to negating overall ability with individual mistakes
Fortune-telling future failure and catastrophizing; excessive reliance on external approval
Avoids public practice and exposure (hiding behind the computer), reducing help-seeking from the support system
Insufficient self-confidence and fear of being judged; motivation is impaired

target_behavior.behavior: Self-denial and negative labels (such as 'I am a failure / useless')
antecedent: Making mistakes at work (forgetting to complete tasks on time)
Recalling small mistakes at work or in life
When thinking about pursuing one's dream of baseball commentary
target_behavior.core_reason: The negative core belief 'I am not good enough'; generalizes individual mistakes into overall lack of ability in order to avoid facing external evaluation
target_behavior.function: Escapes the anxiety of being judged by others through self-blame and self-attack, gaining a false sense of control
target_behavior.consequence: Motivation declines, self-esteem is damaged, affecting work performance and aggravating relationship tension with the partner

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding practice and public exposure (hiding behind the computer, avoiding trying commentary)
antecedent: Thinking about practicing or demonstrating commentary skills
Encountering possible opportunities for public speaking/performance
target_behavior.core_reason: Predicting failure and being judged, holding a black-and-white standard that imperfection equals failure
target_behavior.consequence: Skills cannot accumulate, progress toward the dream stalls, and frustration increases

target_behavior.behavior: Catastrophizing worries about the future ('I will fail / I will disappoint her')
antecedent: After proposing, thinking about future roles and responsibilities
Time and energy pressure caused by juggling three jobs
target_behavior.core_reason: External recognition-oriented conditions of worth and strong fear of failure
target_behavior.function: Suppresses action by rehearsing the worst scenario in order to avoid potential shame and damaged relationships
target_behavior.consequence: Increased anxiety, blocked decision-making and action, strained relationships and increased life stress
